subject: Add monotonic clock calibration handling if clock speed is not found (#2776)
reason: The change is confined to monotonicInit_x86linux() in src/monotonic.c, which is compiled only when USE_PROCESSOR_CLOCK is defined (a non-default build flag set via CFLAGS=-DUSE_PROCESSOR_CLOCK). The fuzzer runs the builds the runner supplies, which use the default POSIX clock_gettime path, so the new TSC calibration code is compiled out and unreachable. Even in a USE_PROCESSOR_CLOCK build it only runs at startup on CPUs whose /proc/cpuinfo model name lacks a GHz figure, and changes no command reply, replication, persistence, or config behaviour that a scenario could observe.
